entries.reason: iOS 6 rounds a corner with a circular arc only, so the continuous curve is a mask of the layer laid over its circular clip
entries.effect: a layer that clips to its bounds with a corner radius and is set to continuous gets a mask of the continuous corner shape, within 1.5% of the area the system covers, kept in step with its bounds and radius; a layer that does not clip, or has a mask of its own, keeps its circular corners
